title: Fix inconsistent function-invoke fallback & structured-output parse failures across Hosted/Dedicated/Private
creator: Arjun Patel
description: Multiple enterprise customers reported intermittent failures when using function/tool-calling and structured JSON outputs. Symptoms: SDKs and integrations receive invalid or truncated JSON for function responses, or responses that lack the expected function_call metadata, causing downstream parsing exceptions and user-facing errors. Reports span Hosted API, Dedicated clusters, and Private installs (on-prem/VPC). This ticket coordinates investigation, triage, fixes, rollout plan, and customer comms.
incident_timeline: 2026-03-02: First customer (AcmeAI) opened support case — observed truncated JSON in function response when fallback routing occurred during capacity pressure.
2026-03-03: Similar reports from FinEdge (Dedicated) and HealthMesh (Private) — patterns matched: structured output parse errors and missing function_call metadata.
2026-03-03 18:00 UTC: Engineering on-call reproduced partial JSON in streaming test harness; created minimal repro and escalated to runtime team.
2026-03-04: Triage call with PM, Runtime, SDK, and Infra teams — declared P0 due to production impact on multiple customers.
2026-03-05: Hotfix plan drafted; immediate mitigations applied (preserve older routing policy for Hosted canaries and enable per-tenant stricter parser on Dedicated).
2026-03-09: Root cause analysis completed; regressions identified in routing fallback logic and streaming chunk boundary handling, and proxy header normalization for Private installs.
2026-03-11: Fix PRs opened and reviewed; integration tests added. Begin staged rollout to Hosted canaries.
2026-03-13: SDK patch released to tolerate boundary splits and improved retry/merge logic; monitoring dashboards updated. This ticket updated with rollout status.
root_cause_summary: Two interacting regressions: (1) routing fallback path to compatible model variants dropped the function_call hint (metadata) under capacity fallback because of an older serializer branch not setting the function_call field; (2) a streaming encoder change introduced chunk boundaries that could split JSON objects across frames without a robust reassembly layer, producing transient invalid JSON to clients. Additionally, some Private deployments behind customer-managed proxies had inconsistent Content-Type and transfer-encoding handling, exacerbating truncation.
mitigations_and_workarounds: Short-term (minutes-hours): Preserve previous routing serializer for Hosted canaries; enable per-tenant parser leniency for affected Dedicated clusters; provide a customer-side SDK patch that attempts incremental reassembly of stream chunks and tolerates certain whitespace/boundary splits.

Medium-term (days): Revert the serializer change that dropped function_call metadata; add streaming reassembly buffer on server-side and SDK; normalize headers in Private agent installer (patch v1.4.3).

Long-term (weeks): Add backward-compatible tests for function_call preservation across routing variants; strengthen e2e tests with representative customer prompt sets; add SLOs and automated canary gates for function-calling correctness.
deploy_plan: Hosted: deploy runtime PR to canary pool (5%) and monitor function_call_success_rate for 24h before 25% ramp; full roll at 72h if green.
Dedicated: schedule patch window with affected customers; start with non-critical reserved pools then expand. For Dedicated customers with strict SLAs, apply hotpatch via maintenance window.
Private: publish agent package v1.4.3 with header normalization and streaming patch; provide step-by-step upgrade doc and support-assisted upgrade for impacted customers.
test_plan: Unit tests verifying function_call metadata preserved across routing code paths.
Streaming integration tests that force chunk splits at JSON token boundaries and validate reassembly logic.
E2E against customer-provided prompt sets from AcmeAI, FinEdge, HealthMesh (with permission) to verify no parse failures.
Chaos test: simulate capacity pressure and fallback to ensure function_call hints persist.
CI gating: add new tests to runtime and sdk suites; require green before merge.
monitoring_and_alerts: New alert: parser_error_rate > 0.1% for 5m triggers P0 incident channel.
Dashboard: Function calling health across regions/deploy types; breakdown by model variant and routing policy.
customer_communications: 2026-03-05: Initial notification to affected customers acknowledging issue and mitigations in progress (support ticket links included).
2026-03-11: Follow-up with ETA for SDK and runtime fixes; offered workaround and prioritized upgrade slots for Dedicated/Private customers.
Post-fix: Provide summary of root cause, what changed, and recommended SDK/runtime versions; offer 1:1 verification session for each impacted account.
postmortem_actions: Implement automated canary checks specifically for function_call semantics before routing fallbacks are permitted.
Add contractual checklist for Private agent upgrades to ensure proxy header compatibility.
Improve observability: log preserved function_call metadata at routing decision points for 7-day retention.
Train support and SRE on new runbook steps for similar reports.
notes: Reviewer feedback: focus on minimal latency impact for streaming reassembly; avoid adding large buffers that would increase tail latency.
Trade-offs discussed: aggressive reassembly vs. lenient parser behavior in SDK — consensus to fix server serialization and keep SDK resilient for a short transition window.
Follow-up: evaluate whether function_call should be promoted into a first-class header to avoid metadata loss across routing layers.
